requirements.statement: Preserve valid preparations containing container terms while rejecting arbitrary object-only descriptions without food indication.

negative_control_evidence.failure_mode: novel object modifier accepted as food
negative_control_evidence.plausible_wrong_implementation: Mirror only a finite descriptor list in implementation and tests.
negative_control_evidence.procedure: Execute compiled cleanup with modifiers absent from candidate enumerations and valid food-bearing container variants.
negative_control_evidence.expected: Novel object-only descriptions are rejected and valid linked food variants survive.
negative_control_evidence.observed: Novel descriptors were rejected across multiple container heads while food-bearing variants survived.

requirements.statement: Resolve 230g ameixa roxa through the deterministic local path to a real plum reference while preserving quantity and external-dependency independence.

negative_control_evidence.failure_mode: local plum alias depends on semantic/AI provider
negative_control_evidence.plausible_wrong_implementation: Resolve the variant only when external semantic search succeeds.
negative_control_evidence.procedure: Exercise the actual local normalizer and inspect the regression asserting semantic search is not called in the AI-unavailable path.
negative_control_evidence.expected: Local normalization preserves 230g and integration regression forbids semantic search.
negative_control_evidence.observed: Actual normalizer returned 230g ameixa crua; regression contains not-called semantic-search assertion.

requirements.statement: Preserve specific semantic qualifiers and more-specific variants such as ameixa em calda.

negative_control_evidence.failure_mode: specific plum qualifier collapses to raw plum
negative_control_evidence.plausible_wrong_implementation: Normalize every ameixa qualifier to ameixa crua.
negative_control_evidence.procedure: Run actual normalizer with a specific calda variant and compare output against the generic raw alias.
negative_control_evidence.observed: 230g ameixa em calda remained 230g ameixa em calda.
sibling_cases: ameixa roxa maps to raw alias only for curated variant

requirements.statement: Emit low-cardinality nutrition fallback decisions through canonical logging, without user free text or duplicate provider telemetry, and keep logging best-effort.

negative_control_evidence.failure_mode: domain fallback duplicates provider facts or leaks free user content / throws on sink failure
negative_control_evidence.plausible_wrong_implementation: Log arbitrary source text through a parallel sink and propagate persistence failures.
negative_control_evidence.procedure: Execute transpiled telemetry helper with all five reasons, inspect emitted payloads, then force the canonical sink to throw.
negative_control_evidence.expected: Only stable metadata is emitted through meal.inference_fallback and sink failure does not throw.
negative_control_evidence.observed: Five structured events were captured with reason/stage/count only; forced sink failure was swallowed.
